_comment: Performance budgets checked by the automated tests (tests/unit/test_world.gd, test_graphics.gd, test_balance.gd) and reported by tools/godot/perf_report.gd and bench_frame.gd. Triangle counts are at full detail (LOD0) for everything placed in the built world. 'graphics' holds the Low / Medium / High presets (Settings > Graphics), how the first launch picks one for the device, and the frame-rate watchdog that steps down when a phone cannot keep up.

graphics._comment: render_scale: 3D resolution (the UI stays sharp); msaa: 0 off, 1 = 2x; anisotropy: 0 off, 1 = 2x, 2 = 4x; mesh_lod_threshold: pixels of error allowed by automatic mesh LODs; lite_shaders / lite_materials: one-texture terrain and rock, no normal / roughness / metal / AO maps on models; gallery_lamps: real lights among each gallery's 4 hanging lamps (the rest only glow); decor_density: share of trees, bushes, grass and rocks drawn; detail_scale: distance scale for animated crews and far scenery; fps: default frame cap for the preset.

detect._comment: First launch on a phone: Low for the OpenGL ES fallback, under low_ram_gb of memory or a GPU matching low_gpu; High for a GPU matching high_gpu with at least high_ram_gb; Medium otherwise. Desktop builds start on High.

watchdog._comment: While the quality is the automatic choice: after settle_s in play, the average frame rate over window_s must reach min_share of the frame cap, or the quality steps down one level (and the cap drops to 30 on Low).

render_budgets._comment: Most draw calls and triangles per frame in each benchmark view (gallery, surface, plant) of a claim at a stage of the game, by preset; checked by tools/godot/bench_frame.gd --check with a real renderer (CI: Xvfb + Mesa lavapipe, 720x1600). Draw calls include the HUD.
